dtsPropsFor.BottomNav: /** No props - the four tabs and their routes are fixed. Requires a react-router context. */
dtsPropsFor.Toast:
/** No props - renders whatever is in the ui store, or null when nothing is in flight.
   * Trigger it with `useUiStore.getState().showToast(message, action?, durationMs?)`. */
dtsPropsFor.QuickActionFab:
/** No props - the floating action button and its sheet read app state directly.
   * Requires a react-router context. */
dtsPropsFor.UpdatePrompt: /** No props - renders the service-worker update banner, or null when no update is waiting. */
